operations.summary: Creates a new Ticket.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: ID of person to create ticket for.

parameters.name: person_email
parameters.description: If no person_id is given, the ticket is created for a person with this email. If no person is found with this email, one is created.

parameters.name: person_name
parameters.description: If a person is being created, use this as their name.

parameters.name: person_organization
parameters.description: If a person is being created, user this as their organization. If no organization is found with this name, one is created.

parameters.name: person_organization_position
parameters.description: If a person is being created and they belong to an organization, select this as their position.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Subject of the ticket.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: First message of the ticket.

parameters.name: message_as_agent
parameters.description: If true, the message is considered to be written by the API agent rather than the ticket owner. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: message_is_html
parameters.description: If true, the message parameter is treated as HTML.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent assigned to the ticket. Defaults to unassigned.

parameters.name: agent_team_id
parameters.description: Agent team the ticket belongs to.

parameters.name: attach[]
parameters.description: If you wish to upload a file with the ticket, you may send the request as multipart/form-data with the file data going to this parameter.

parameters.name: attach_id[]
parameters.description: The ID of an already uploaded file to include with the ticket.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Category the ticket is in.

parameters.name: department_id
parameters.description: Department the ticket is in. If not specified, uses the default ticket department.

parameters.name: field[]
parameters.description: Value for the specified field.

parameters.name: label[]
parameters.description: Label to apply to the ticket.

parameters.name: language_id
parameters.description: Language the ticket is in.

parameters.name: priority_id
parameters.description: Priority of the ticket.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Product the ticket relates to.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status the ticket is in. Possible values are awaiting_user, awaiting_agent, archived, hidden, resolved. Defaults to awaiting_agent.

parameters.name: sla_id[]
parameters.description: Adds the SLA to the ticket. Can only add SLAs that agents may manually add.

parameters.name: urgency
parameters.description: Urgency of the ticket (1-10).

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: Workflow for the ticket.

operations.summary: Search for Tickets matching criteria

parameters.name: agent_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be assigned to the specified agent ID.

parameters.name: agent_team_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be assigned to an agent in the specific agent team ID.

parameters.name: category_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be in the specified category ID.

parameters.name: department_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be in the specified department ID.

parameters.name: field[#][]
parameters.description: Requires ticket custom field to have the specified value in the listed field.

parameters.name: label[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be have the specified label.

parameters.name: language_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be in the specified language ID.

parameters.name: organization_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be for the specified organization ID.

parameters.name: participant[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be followed by or copied to the specified person ID.

parameters.name: person_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be created by the specified person ID.

parameters.name: priority_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be have the specified priority ID.

parameters.name: product_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be for the specified product ID.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Requires ticket to contain the specified text within it.

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be in the specified status. Possible values are awaiting_user, awaiting_agent, archived, hidden, resolved.

parameters.name: sla_completed
parameters.description: If specified, requires the ticket to have the SLA requirement completed (1) or incomplete (0).

parameters.name: sla_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be have the specified SLA.

parameters.name: sla_status[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be have the specified SLA status. Possible values: ok, warning, fail.

parameters.name: subject[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket subject to match the string provided.

parameters.name: urgency[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be have the specified urgency (1-10).

parameters.name: workflow_id[]
parameters.description: Requires ticket to be have the specified workflow ID.

parameters.name: id_min
parameters.description: Specify min ticket ID (since build 315)

parameters.name: id_max
parameters.description: Specify max ticket ID (since build 315)

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Specify a ref or the beginning characters of a ref (since build 315)

parameters.name: date_created
parameters.description: Constrains results based on the date the ticket was created.

parameters.name: date_resolved
parameters.description: Constrains results based on the date the ticket was first resolved. Unresolved tickets are not included.

parameters.name: date_archived
parameters.description: Constrains results based on the date the ticket was first archived. Unarchived tickets are not included.

parameters.name: date_status
parameters.description: Constrains results based on the date of the last status change.

parameters.name: date_last_agent_reply
parameters.description: Constrains results based on the date of the last agent reply. Tickets without an agent reply are not included.

parameters.name: date_last_user_reply
parameters.description: Constrains results based on the date of the last user reply.

parameters.name: date_last_reply
parameters.description: Constrains results based on the date of the last reply (either a user or agent reply, whichever was latest).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order of the results. Defaults to accessing person's preference or ticket.date_created:desc.

parameters.name: cache_id
parameters.description: If provided, cached results from this result set are used. If it cannot be found or used, the other constraints provided will be used to create a new result set.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the results to fetch.

operations.notes: All constraints are optional. Multiple constraints are AND'd together; multiple values for a single constraint are OR'd.
